lines.text: Of David.
Bless the LORD, O my soul;
all that is within me, bless His holy name.
Bless the LORD, O my soul,
and do not forget all His kind deeds—
He who forgives all your iniquities
and heals all your diseases,
who redeems your life from the Pit
and crowns you with loving devotion and compassion,
who satisfies you with good things,
so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.
The LORD executes righteousness
and justice for all the oppressed.
He made known His ways to Moses,
His deeds to the people of Israel.
The LORD is compassionate and gracious,
slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion.
He will not always accuse us,
nor harbor His anger forever.
He has not dealt with us according to our sins
or repaid us according to our iniquities.
For as high as the heavens are above the earth,
so great is His loving devotion for those who fear Him.

pictures.scene: Peter Paul Rubens, King David Playing the Harp — the old king with his hands on the strings and his eyes lifted, of David, bless the LORD O my soul
pictures.name: pd_rubens_david

pictures.scene: Philippe de Champaigne, Saint Augustine — the burning heart held up toward the light of Truth, all that is within me bless His holy name
pictures.name: pd_champaigne_binnenste

pictures.scene: Rembrandt van Rijn, The Return of the Prodigal Son — the father's two hands laid on the ragged son kneeling against him, bless the LORD O my soul and do not forget all His kind deeds
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_vergeeft

pictures.scene: Peter Paul Rubens, The Miracles of Saint Francis Xavier — the preacher with his hand lifted and the sick crowding up to him with their hands out, He who forgives all your iniquities and heals all your diseases
pictures.name: pd_rubens_geneest

pictures.scene: Diego Velázquez, The Coronation of the Virgin — the crown lowered by the Father and the Son onto the head of the lowly, who redeems your life from the Pit and crowns you with loving devotion and compassion
pictures.name: pd_velazquez_kroont

pictures.scene: Domenichino, Saint John the Evangelist — the young saint with the great eagle beside him looking up into the light, so that your youth is renewed like the eagle's
pictures.name: pd_domenichino_arend

pictures.scene: Jusepe de Ribera, Moses — the old prophet holding the tablets up and laying his finger on the writing, He made known His ways to Moses
pictures.name: pd_ribera_mozes

pictures.scene: James Tissot, The Ark Passes Over the Jordan — the whole nation following the ark between the standing waters, His deeds to the people of Israel
pictures.name: pd_tissot_israel

pictures.scene: Guercino, The Woman Taken in Adultery — Christ turning quietly to the accuser with the woman spared beside Him, He will not always accuse us
pictures.name: pd_guercino_aanklagen

pictures.scene: El Greco, Christ Carrying the Cross — Christ holding the beam with both hands and looking up, He has not dealt with us according to our sins
pictures.name: pd_greco_zonden

pictures.scene: Frederic Edwin Church, Cotopaxi — an enormous burning sky standing far above a low dark earth, for as high as the heavens are above the earth
pictures.name: pd_church_hemelen

pictures.scene: Francisco de Zurbarán, Crucifixion — Christ alone on the cross against the darkness with His arms stretched wide, as far as the east is from the west
pictures.name: pd_zurbaran_oosten
